purpose: Human-reviewed GP onboarding from first conversation through go-live. No automated approvals.
principles: Every stage advance requires a named human reviewer.
Systems may prompt, remind, and block unsafe auto-advance — they never approve credentials, provider numbers, or go-live.
External agency outcomes are tracked as dependencies, not practice decisions.
Practice voice only — no recruitment-agency framing or outcome guarantees.
Medicare provider numbers are issued by Services Australia; WMC does not issue or guarantee them.

flowchart LR

  B --> C[3 Credential checks]
  C --> D[4 Provider-number preparation]
  D --> E[5 Session allocation]
  E --> F[6 Orientation]
  F --> G[7 Go-live]
  B -.->|pause / withdraw| X[Paused or withdrawn]
  C -.-> X
  D -.->|awaiting Services Australia| D
  E -.->|capacity change| E
  G --> H[Settling / business as usual]

stages.label: Initial discussion
stages.goal: Clarify mutual interest, practice fit, and next information needs — without promising placement.

humanGate.action: Mark discussion complete and invite EOI, or pause / decline politely

adminTasks.task: Log enquiry source and preferred contact method
Share practice support boundaries (provider numbers, no guarantees)
Offer DPA/19AB Navigator and Practice Support Matrix if relevant
Invite Expression of Interest when mutual interest is clear

doctorTasks.task: Ask clarifying questions about sessions, nursing support, and start timing
Review practice public information and FAQ
Decide whether to submit an EOI

exitCriteria: Named admin records outcome of discussion
Doctor invited to EOI or case paused/withdrawn with reason

stages.label: EOI review
stages.goal: Human review of Expression of Interest for fit, completeness, and conversation priority — never auto-reject by score alone.

humanGate.action: Queue priority decision: progress / request more info / pause / decline

adminTasks.task: Check EOI completeness and obvious missing fields
Use EOI scoring as queue prioritisation aid only (not approval)
Record human review decision and rationale
Reply to doctor with next step or clarifying questions

doctorTasks.task: Submit EOI with AHPRA / fellowship / availability details

dependencies.label: Named reviewer decision before stage advance

exitCriteria: Doctor notified of outcome or clarification path

stages.label: Credential checks
stages.goal: Sight and record evidence of registration, indemnity, identity, and working rights. Practice verifies documents; external bodies own the credentials.

humanGate.action: Confirm documents sighted and acceptable for onboarding to continue — not an AHPRA approval

adminTasks.task: Send credential document request list
Sight current AHPRA registration evidence
Sight professional indemnity for intended period
Sight photo ID and working rights evidence
Human sign-off that pack is complete enough to proceed

doctorTasks.task: Provide photo ID and working rights evidence
Provide current CV if not already attached to EOI

exitCriteria: Human credential gate approved to proceed (practice process only)

stages.label: Provider-number preparation
stages.goal: Help the doctor prepare a location-linked Services Australia application. Never issue or approve a provider number.

humanGate.action: Confirm practice location pack supplied; track external status — do not mark as WMC-approved PN

adminTasks.task: Supply verified practice name, address, and location identifiers
Reconfirm Services Australia is the issuer; WMC does not approve PNs
Record application status as doctor reports (lodged / awaiting / issued)
Note any billing constraints if still awaiting_external at later stages

doctorTasks.task: Lodge or update Services Australia provider number application for this location
Share application / outcome correspondence status with the practice

dependencies.label: Admin confirms pack sent; does not approve SA outcome

exitCriteria: Doctor application status recorded (may still be awaiting_external)
Human acknowledges billing implications if not yet issued
stages.advanceWhileAwaitingNote: May advance with explicit human acknowledgement that Medicare billing for this location may be constrained until Services Australia confirms.

stages.label: Session allocation
stages.goal: Agree consulting sessions against rooms, nursing cover, and practice need.

humanGate.action: Approve proposed session plan after capacity check — mutual agreement, not auto-assign

adminTasks.task: Check room and nursing capacity for proposed windows
Draft session plan with doctor preferences
Record mutual agreement on sessions (human approval)
Prepare booking / HotDoc visibility for agreed sessions (pre go-live)

doctorTasks.task: Confirm preferred days, hours, and start timing
Review and accept or request changes to draft session plan

dependencies.label: Mutual agreement recorded by practice manager

stages.label: Orientation
stages.goal: Introduce practice systems, Medicare workflows (local), nursing, reception, and team — without substituting for external credentials.

humanGate.action: Confirm orientation delivered or scheduled with named owner; software access granted after ID checks

adminTasks.task: Schedule orientation (layout, emergency, privacy, contacts)
Arrange clinical software access after identity checks
Coordinate nursing and reception introductions
Deliver local Medicare billing workflow orientation
Human sign-off that orientation essentials are complete or explicitly deferred with plan

doctorTasks.task: Raise workflow questions before first patient session

exitCriteria: Orientation essentials complete or deferred with dated plan

stages.label: Go-live
stages.goal: Human-authorised first patient session. Systems may show a readiness checklist; only a named person can release go-live.

humanGate.action: Explicit go-live approval after checklist review — no automated release

adminTasks.task: Review go-live checklist (credentials, sessions, orientation, PN status notes)
If PN still awaiting_external, record explicit billing-constraint acknowledgement
Enable agreed sessions for booking
Named human approves go-live (timestamp + identity)
Assign day-one support contact

doctorTasks.task: Confirm first session date and arrival time
Confirm no outstanding required personal documents

dependencies.label: Prior stage human gates complete (or waived with recorded rationale)
Provider number status understood for billing

exitCriteria: Go-live approval recorded with actor and timestamp

caseStatuses.awaiting_external: Blocked or constrained by external agency
caseStatuses.ready_for_go_live: Checklist complete; awaiting human go-live approval

transitions.note: Doctor submission can move to in_review; progression still human-gated
Time-based settling window may open; still no auto credential approvals
Return only if reopened for support tracking

stageAdvanceRule.summary: A stage may move to gate_approved only via POST with reviewerId + decision. Server rejects missing human fields.
automationAllowed: Blocking advance when required tasks incomplete
